newsitem.title: MOROCCO: U.S. special envoy Dennis Ross leaves Morocco.
newsitem.headline: U.S. special envoy Dennis Ross leaves Morocco.

text.p: U.S. special envoy Dennis Ross left Rabat on Thursday for Israel after what he termed "very thorough" talks with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat, the U.S. embassy said.
Ross was to have talks with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on the threatened peace process in the Middle East.
Neither Ross nor Arafat made any statement to reporters as they left their meeting.
But Ross, who met Moroccan King Hassan after arriving on Wednesday night, in a statement issued by the embassy termed his talks with Arafat as "a very thorough discussion"
He added: "The purpose of my mission is to make an assessment of the situation in the Middle East for the president and the secretary of state and to report back to them by this weekend."
